notes.title: Update 1.1 is now live
notes.notes:
Hey all, we just pushed the newest update for BD99: Update 1.1. The main focus for this update was reworking 'endless' mode to make it more challenging and engaging. In addition we also added a few new weapons, perks, and quality of life improvements. Much of this work was done by our new intern Javier. He's a great designer and developer and we look forward to working with him more in the future. You can check out some of his solo work on Itch: 

https://trivitown.itch.io/


[h1]Endless mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] After ~20 minutes enemies will gradually get tougher
[*] Bosses now drop extra large EXP orbs
[*] Changes to enemy spawn-rates late-game
[*] All previous endless mode scores have been cleared and the scoreboards are empty. Endless mode is much more difficult now and you will not be able to achieve the same scores that were previously possible
[/list]
[h1]Autoaim[/h1]
[list]
[*] Although we still recommend playing mostly with autoaim off we have made some changes to make the option appear earlier and more obviously
[*] Advanced Targeting unlocks sooner
[*] Advanced Targeting is less expensive
[*] Added lobby 'tooltips' to call attention to newly unlocked lobby settings
[/list]
[h1]Weapons and Perks[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Weapon: Money Gun
[*] New Perks: Tractor Beam, Radar, Vortex Grenade
[*] 'Dog' reworked: The perk is less expensive and the dog starts off fairly slow/weak but gets faster and stronger over time
[*] 'ROI' is more expensive
[*] Flak Gun upgrade 'Passive Flak' behavior changed: it now shoots a blast of flak every second instead of continuously firing individual pieces
[*] Billiards Gun has bigger balls
[/list]
[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added more announcer lines
[*] Added/fixed tooltips when you mouse over them in the pause screen. This was in an early version of the game but was (accidentally) disabled at some point during EA
[*] New cosmetics
[*] Some changes to screenshake
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added more robust handling of save files. This should lessen or completely prevent the 'corrupted save file' issue reported by a few players. In the rare case of a corrupted save file there are now clear error messages and options to try to repair or delete the corrupted save
[*] Fixed an issue where the perk list could overlap the menu buttons in the pause screen, on ultrawide monitors
[*] Fixed an issue where dps would sometimes display negative numbers
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies would sometimes moonwalk away
[*] Fixed an issue with slaughterhouse scores not saving/showing correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where page up/down would sometimes be disabled when viewing scoreboards
[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented achieving 'singular focus'
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0 status update
notes.notes:
Hi. As you've probably noticed September has come and gone and we didn't launch the 1.0 update. Unfortunately, between personal factors and misjudging the amount of work left to do, we didn't end up hitting our September target. We are still hard at work on the update and it's coming along pretty nicely.

In fact, we are currently doing playtests for the update. If you'd like to get advance access to 1.0, get your name in the credits, and help us launch the best update possible [url=https://discord.gg/MCbpwWdjrU]let us know on Discord [/url]and we can talk more about playtesting. 

We are hoping to get the update out in November, but I don't want to say anything concrete until we're confident we can deliver. That being said, we're really happy with how the update is coming along and we're optimistic you're going to love it.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 0.9 is NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[h3]Thank you so much for being patient with us while we worked on our first content update! We're really excited to share this update and of course if you have any issues please reach out to us on the Steam discussions or on our [url=https://discord.gg/MCbpwWdjrU]Discord[/url] (which we check a bit more frequently). Anyway, here's some patch notes:[/h3]

[h1]Weight Training[/h1]
Use weight training to mix and match difficulty modifiers and raise your 'weight.' Winning with added weight will earn you more money, unlocks, and get you on separate VIP leaderboards.
[list]
[*] 8 difficulty modifiers: Rough Start, Skateboard, One Handed, Stationary Shooting, Inebriated, Double Trouble, Speed Freak, Road Rage[/list]
[h1]Weapon Override[/h1]
Start the round with any previously used weapon. The cost of the weapon will be deducted at the beginning of the round (you will start in debt)


[h1]Twitch Integration[/h1]
The Twitch integration has been fully reworked. The new Twitch integration only requires a channel name and it should be significantly more stable. Viewers can vote on perks/weapons using the commands !a, !b, !c, !pass, !reroll


[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] New weapons: Burst Rifle, Flak Gun, Elephant Gun, Billiards Gun, Bow and Arrow, Fireworks Gun
[*] New perks: Quick Cash, Sharpshooter, Airmail, Flashbang, Snowstorm, Frozen Assets
[*] New songs: 6 new songs by Karl Casey of White Bat Audio and 1 new original track
[*] 35+ new cosmetics: Unlock them by using difficulty modifiers, completing the game with different weapons, and more[/list]
[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*] The intensity of the menu glow can now be adjusted
[*] Leaderboards can be viewed at any time from the lobby (the second lobby room must be unlocked first)[/list]
[h1]Other fixes/changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tweaks to various SFX
[*] Auto aim penalty only applies if auto aim is actually used (not just equipped)
[*] Attack drone fires faster and does more damage
[*] The 'Credit' perk has been completely reworked. It now only appears when you are low/negative on money and can be stacked
[*] New announcer lines
[*] Tweaks to the way projectiles bounce off enemies and walls[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9 details, release date, and trailer
notes.notes:

notes.title: BloodDome99 is OUT NOW (and day 1 patch notes)
notes.notes:
It's finally here! If you've been with us for a while, thank you so much for your support. If you're just joining us now, welcome! BloodDome99 is now live in Early Access

[h1]Launch[/h1]
[list]
[*] As a small thank you for everyone who's been with us so far we are running a 20% launch discount for the next 7 days
[*] If you want to support us additionally, [b]we would really appreciate you leaving a review[/b]. Steam reviews are incredibly important for small developers like us. The number of reviews on a (small) game is the main factor that determines how likely Steam is to recommend it to users who are trying to discover new games. So your review could directly mean more people play BD99, which means we can make more and better games
[/list]


[h1]Day 1 patch[/h1]
We are also releasing a small content patch so that everyone will have something new to try (even our beta participants and playtesters). We plan to continue releasing regular content updates throughout Early Access, so please consider [url=https://discord.gg/YTCeZbvay6]joining our Discord[/url] to let us know what you'd like to see

[h2]Advanced Targeting[/h2]
Unlock the Advanced Targeting kiosk from the vending machine to use auto aim, turbo fire, and other aiming options.

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 new weapons
[*] 9 new hats
[*] 2 new fractal gun upgrades (and some visual changes)
[*] BDC console now asks for confirmation instead of directly opening the Steam page
[*] Various small balance changes
[/list]
